name: infantry_ticket_create
description: Create a ticket on the Infantry AI board (it lands in todo, the current sprint, or in backlog with status backlog; nothing runs until infantry_ticket_start starts it, and a backlog ticket is never started). The description is stored verbatim, multi-line included. role / provider / model pin who runs it (infantry_list_harnesses lists the provider ids and their models). The answer says what was saved.

description.description: Full brief, Markdown, any number of lines; stored exactly as given.

projectId.description: Project the ticket belongs to (default: this session's project).

status.description: Column the new ticket enters: todo (default, the current sprint) or backlog (parked, never started until moved to todo).

epic.description: File the ticket under this epic of its project (id or name). An unknown epic refuses the call.

notify.description: Who to notify on every comment: agent ids, session ids, role:<name> (resolved at send time) or owner (the human user, an app notice). Default: you plus the project's default list.

verbose.description: true = answer with the full ticket (description included). Default false: a one-line confirmation.

role.description: Role that runs it (stored as role:<id>), e.g. backend.

provider.description: Harness (provider id) that runs it, e.g. claude or opencode: see infantry_list_harnesses.

model.description: Model pin, one of that harness's models: see infantry_list_harnesses.

weight.description: Ticket weight 1-5 by how likely the ticket is to come back wrong, not its size. 0 clears it on update.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the ticket's worker: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (off = the harness default).

contextLimit.description: Context limit for the session in tokens (200000, 200k, 1m; off = none, the default).

runner.description: Where the ticket starts: local, a registered runner name or any; none clears the pin on update.

name: infantry_agent_switch
description: Switch an agent from its in-progress ticket A to ticket B: A goes back to todo (top) with a handoff and its branch kept, B heads the agent's queue, the worker ends like unassign (now = at once) and B starts for the same agent on exit (deferred: the worker ends after its turn). With no current ticket it is an assign. Same as `infantry agent switch <agent> <ticketId> [--now]`.

agentId.description: Agent profile id, or its unique name.

ticketId.description: The ticket to switch to: full id, or its 8-char suffix.

now.description: End the worker at once instead of after its current turn.

verbose.description: Return the full ticket instead of one line.

name: infantry_agent_queue
description: List or change ONE agent's persistent ticket queue. action list (default), add (ticketId, optional at = 1-based place), remove (ticketId), move (ticketId, at) or clear. agentId is a profile id or a unique agent name. Only todo tickets can be queued, a ticket is in one queue, and a queue holds at most limits.agentTasks.queueMax tickets. When the agent's worker ends, the lowest-place ticket starts on that agent; `startNext` never picks a queued ticket. Same as `infantry agent queue <agent> [add <id> [--at n] | rm <id> | mv <id> <n> | clear]`.

agentId.description: Agent profile id, or its unique name.

action.description: list (default), add, remove, move or clear.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix (add, remove, move).

at.description: 1-based place in the queue (add: default the end; move: required).

name: infantry_epic_base
description: Read, set or clear ONE epic's base branch: new tickets in the epic cut their branch from it, overriding the project's base. A branch that does not resolve where tickets are cut is refused with the reason. Tickets already started keep their recorded base.

branch.description: Branch to set; omit (with clear unset) to read.

clear.description: true removes the setting; the epic's tickets fall back to the project's base.

name: infantry_ticket_get
description: Read ONE ticket back: title, verbatim description, status, project, role/agent, provider, model, branch, worker session, attached images.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

detail.description: summary = id, title, status, role, model, branch, epic, open comment count, first chars of the description (default); full = every field and the whole description.

related.description: Accepted for compatibility; the description is returned as stored.

name: infantry_ticket_update
description: Edit ONE ticket (full id or the 8-char id). A field left out keeps its stored value; the description, when given, replaces the stored one verbatim. Set role / provider / model here BEFORE infantry_ticket_start: a start runs what the ticket holds. The answer says what was saved.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

description.description: New full description, stored exactly as given.

epic.description: File the ticket under this epic (id or name), or none to clear.

notify.description: Replace the ticket notify list (agent ids, session ids, role:<name>).

addNotify.description: Agent ids, session ids or role:<name> to ADD to the notify list.

removeNotify.description: Entries (agent id, session id or role:<name>) to REMOVE from the notify list.

verbose.description: true = answer with the full ticket (description included). Default false: a one-line confirmation.

role.description: Role that runs it (stored as role:<id>), e.g. backend.

provider.description: Harness (provider id) that runs it, e.g. claude or opencode: see infantry_list_harnesses.

model.description: Model pin, one of that harness's models: see infantry_list_harnesses.

weight.description: Ticket weight 1-5 by how likely the ticket is to come back wrong, not its size. 0 clears it on update.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the ticket's worker: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (off = the harness default).

contextLimit.description: Context limit for the session in tokens (200000, 200k, 1m; off = none, the default).

runner.description: Where the ticket starts: local, a registered runner name or any; none clears the pin on update.

name: infantry_ticket_move
description: Move ONE ticket to a status (full id or 8-char id), e.g. done when your work is finished, or todo, or backlog, and/or reorder it: ticket order inside a column is priority. Give at most one of before / after, top, bottom or position (0 = top). To START a ticket use infantry_ticket_start. The answer reads back the stored ticket and its position (0 = top).

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

status.description: Target status, e.g. done, todo, backlog. Optional when before, top or bottom is given.

before.description: Place the ticket just above this ticket (full id or 8-char suffix), which must be in the target column.

after.description: Place the ticket just below this ticket (full id or 8-char suffix), which must be in the target column.

top.description: Place the ticket at the top of the column (highest priority).

bottom.description: Place the ticket at the bottom of the column.

position.description: Place the ticket at this index of the column, 0 = the top (past the end = the bottom).

verbose.description: true = answer with the full ticket (description included). Default false: a one-line confirmation.

name: infantry_ticket_start
instructions: Board: create, update and read board tickets. To put an agent to work on a ticket, pin its role / provider / model (infantry_list_harnesses lists the harnesses and their models) with infantry_ticket_create / infantry_ticket_update, then start it with infantry_ticket_start: the worker runs on the ticket's own branch and the ticket goes In Progress. infantry_spawn alone works outside the board.
description: Start ONE ticket: THE way to put an agent to work on a ticket. The worker runs the ticket's role, provider and model, in its own git worktree on branch ticket/<short-id>-<slug>, and the ticket goes In Progress with you recorded as its starter. Pin role / provider / model first with infantry_ticket_create or infantry_ticket_update. A ticket whose lane is busy is queued; one held by open prerequisites, or that cannot start, is refused with the reason. Starting a ticket already in progress returns its worker.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

verbose.description: true = answer with the full ticket (description included). Default false: a one-line confirmation.

name: infantry_ticket_close
description: Close ONE ticket in a single call (the lead's clean finish): the ticket goes to done, its worker is stopped and its session removed, its worktree is removed ONLY when it is clean and merged (otherwise the close is refused with the reason and nothing changes; unmerged work is never deleted), and the lane's next queued ticket starts. A ticket that is already done is cleaned up the same way. Use keepWorktree to leave the worktree for the periodic sweep.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

summary.description: Optional done comment (commit, what changed, what was tested), stored on the ticket.

keepWorktree.description: true = skip the worktree step and its merged-and-clean check.

name: infantry_ticket_restart
description: Put a worker back on an in_progress ticket whose worker died or ended (the lead gets a mail when one dies). It first RESUMES the dead session (the same conversation, in the same worktree). If that resume dies within board.restartResumeSeconds (default 20) or cannot be tried, it starts a FRESH session on the SAME worktree and branch with the ticket brief and a 'continue from your last commit' note. Everything the worker committed is kept. Refused when the ticket is not in_progress or its worker is still alive. fresh=true skips the resume.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

fresh.description: true = skip the resume and start the fresh session at once.

name: infantry_ticket_comment
description: Comment on a ticket (the extra channel next to mail): every agent on the ticket's notify list gets ONE short mail line at once. kind done = the work is finished (say the commit); finish a ticket with kind=done complete=true, which stores the done comment and moves the ticket to done in one step (ONE completion notice). A done comment or move on a ticket already done changes nothing: the answer says who completed it and when, and the text is kept as a note. issue = a problem to answer, note = anything else (default). With commentId and no ticketId/body, RESOLVES that comment (no mail). Read them with infantry_ticket_comments.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix (add).

complete.description: With kind=done: also move the ticket to done in the same step and send one completion event. On a ticket already done: nothing changes and the text is stored as a note.

wakeKind.description: Optional: the notice kind this comment wakes the notify list under (default comment.<kind>), e.g. worker.failed. The setting notify.wake.kinds decides whether that kind wakes a session or only lands in the inbox.

wakeKey.description: Optional dedupe key for wakeKind (a run id, a ticket id): the same kind+key wakes a session at most once, across comments and mails.

state.description: open (default) or resolved: a comment that needs no answer can be posted resolved.

commentId.description: Resolve: the comment's id (the 8-char id is enough).

name: infantry_ticket_notify
description: Read a ticket's notify list as JSON {createdBy, notify:[entry]}. An entry is an agent id, session id, role:<name> or owner, with an optional #inbox (kept in the inbox, no turn; the default #wake is not written). Change it with infantry_ticket_update notify/addNotify/removeNotify.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

name: infantry_ticket_comments
description: Read a ticket's comments, one compact line each (id, kind/state, author, time, text). which = latestOpen (default: the newest unresolved one), latest, first or all; kind filters done|issue|note|handoff; limit keeps the newest N of all. detail=full gives the whole body of every comment; commentId fetches ONE comment in full.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

kind.description: Only comments of this kind: done | issue | note.

limit.description: With which=all: keep only the newest N.

detail.description: compact | full. full = whole comment bodies, also with which=all.

commentId.description: Fetch ONE comment in full by id (the 8-char id is enough); ticketId is then optional.

name: infantry_board
description: The board in one call: tickets grouped by column (backlog, todo, in_progress, pending, done), one line each with its worker (role, session id) and the worker's live state. Compact by default (done: last 5; backlog and todo: first 10 lines and a count); pass columns / limit for more.

projectId.description: Project whose tickets to summarise. Default: the caller's own project; "all" (pm / owner callers only) covers every project, each line prefixed [projectId].

columns.description: Comma-separated columns to show, e.g. in_progress,pending (backlog, todo, in_progress, pending, done). Default: all, compact.

limit.description: At most this many ticket lines per column (done: the newest).

waiting.description: true = only the tickets whose worker flagged itself waiting.

name: infantry_ticket_archive
description: Archive tickets out of the live board (reversible with infantry_ticket_restore): give ids, or epicId (an epic with its tickets), or status + olderThanDays (a lane filter, e.g. done older than 30 days). In-progress tickets are never archived. Archived tickets keep everything and still show in related files. PM and owner only.

ids.description: Ticket ids (ticket-xxxxxxxx or the 8 char suffix).

epicId.description: Archive every ticket of this epic.

projectId.description: Limit a lane or epic filter to this project.

olderThanDays.description: Only tickets last changed more than N days ago.

dryRun.description: Count what would move, move nothing.

name: infantry_ticket_restore
description: Restore archived tickets to the live board exactly as they were (lane, position, links whose other end is live, branch, project, epic): give ids, or epicId to restore every archived ticket of an epic. PM and owner only.

ids.description: Ticket ids (ticket-xxxxxxxx or the 8 char suffix).

epicId.description: Restore every archived ticket of this epic.

dryRun.description: Count what would move, move nothing.

name: infantry_archive
description: Read the ticket archive: op list (newest first), show (one id, full text), search (text in title / description / id), count.

ids.description: Ticket ids (ticket-xxxxxxxx or the 8 char suffix).

epicId.description: Limit a list to this epic.

name: infantry_ticket_files
description: Files changed by a ticket (status A/M/D/R, +added -removed, path), or with `path` the tickets that changed matching files (glob, `**` ok; no wildcard = any path containing it). Recorded when each ticket went done, kept after its branch is deleted. Cheaper than grepping git history.

name: infantry_ticket_related_files
description: Call this BEFORE grepping: the tickets that changed the same files as this ticket (ranked by overlap), and the union of the files they changed, each with the ticket ids that touched it.

name: infantry_ticket_epic
description: Move tickets to an epic, or out of every epic (epic=none). One call moves one or many (tickets[] and/or ticketId). The epic is an id or a name of the tickets' project; an unknown name creates it (only when something moves), an unknown epic id refuses. Only the epic changes: status, order, branch and worker are kept. An in_progress ticket whose branch was cut from another base than the new epic's is NOT moved (the answer says why) unless force is true. One unknown ticket id refuses the whole call. Same as `infantry ticket epic <id...> <epic|none> [--force]`.

ticketId.description: One ticket id (full or 8-char suffix); added to tickets.

epic.description: Epic id, epic name, or none.

force.description: true moves in_progress tickets even when the new epic cuts from another base (their branch keeps its base).

name: infantry_ticket_assign
description: Assign a todo ticket to an EXISTING agent (profile id or unique name). Default starts it on that agent; an agent on another in-progress ticket is refused (use infantry_agent_switch or queue). queue=true adds it to the agent's queue at `at` instead. Same as `infantry ticket assign <id> <agent> [--queue] [--at n]`.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

agentId.description: Agent profile id, or its unique name.

queue.description: Add to the agent's queue instead of starting.

verbose.description: true = answer with the full ticket.

name: infantry_ticket_unassign
description: Take ONE in_progress ticket off its worker: the ticket goes back to the top of todo with its branch and work kept, and a handoff comment (with your note) feeds the next worker's brief. A busy worker finishes its current turn first; now ends it at once. Refused unless the ticket is in_progress. Same as `infantry ticket unassign <id> [--now] [--note <text>]`.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

now.description: End the worker at once instead of after its current turn.

note.description: A note for the next worker, added to the handoff comment.

verbose.description: true = answer with the full ticket.

name: infantry_ticket_delete
description: Delete ONE ticket (full id or 8-char suffix) with its links. An unknown or ambiguous id is refused and nothing is deleted. A ticket in progress is refused: unassign or close it first.

ticketId.description: Full ticket id, or its 8-char suffix.

name: infantry_pipeline
description: Read the project's verification pipeline: its stages, each commit's current stage (who moved it, when, evidence), and the running checks. configured:false when the project has no pipeline.

name: infantry_pipeline_record
description: Report pipeline state instead of being asked by mail: move a commit to a stage (commit + stage + optional evidence), or start / ping / finish the running check (check + scope; start also needs commit + what).

stage.description: One of the project's configured stage names.

check.description: start, ping or finish: act on the running check instead of a stage.

scope.description: The worktree / build dir the check runs in; empty for the default.
